content_of_post_to_answer: Which is harder to open, a window or a mind?
answer: A window only resists because of a physical force; a mind resists because opening it can threaten identity. People rarely reject new ideas because they lack evidence—they reject them because accepting the evidence may require admitting they were wrong, changing habits, or losing belonging. That is why curiosity is easier before we build a self-image around being right.
